name: Ysmeral, the Soul Shepherd
behaviour: Guards the Soul Spring and will not stray far from it. Calls down strikes like a godling, and every 14 s calls every loose soul nearby to herself; each one that reaches her heals her. Summons the realm's spirits at 70% and 35% life and casts faster below half. Her fall leaves a Grand Soul and 90 s without hunger. Rises again after five minutes.
look: A tall veiled figure in a pale-blue robe with a halo and a shepherd's crook, six captive souls circling her.
lore: She tends the souls that fall in the Veil, and none of them are meant for you.
